videos.desc: A man sitting in his car reads a text that says 'Hey, sorry, but I have to cancel our plans tonight', looks briefly shocked, then breaks into a huge grin and fist-pumps because now he can stay home.
videos.said: My friend cancels our plans tonight! Oh yes! Now I stay home! I am so happy!

videos.desc: An animated woman waits happily at a candlelit rooftop dinner table with spaghetti and a wrapped gift, waving as her partner arrives. He apologetically tells her he cannot stay and leaves, and she is left crying alone at the table, staring sadly at the untouched dinner and present.
videos.said: *Door opens* Baralla, I can't stay. But...tonight? I'm sorry. Really. Oh.

videos.desc: Two animated friends at an outdoor cafe table whisper into each other's ears with shocked faces, sneak glances at an old couple at a nearby table while saying they are not looking, then sip their coffee innocently.
videos.said: She told me everything. No way! Don't look now. I'm not looking!

videos.desc: A girl with freckles holds her phone at arm's length in her bright bedroom, waves at the camera and says good morning, explaining she is filming a little vlog today while smiling and fixing her hair.
videos.said: good morning i'm filming a little vlog today

videos.desc: Two street performers juggle colorful clubs inside a chalk circle on a cobblestone old-town square, tossing clubs high while a large crowd rings them, watches and applauds, and the pair finally bow beside their tip hat.

A young woman in a flowery dress serves a big roast turkey to a table full of excited guests, brings out pineapple on demand and even pours water straight into a guest's mouth, then plants her hands on her hips, fed up with being used.
videos.said: Enjoy your meal. You are the best hostess! Do you have pineapple please? Could you pass me the water? You are taking advantage of me a bit as a hostess.

videos.desc: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.

A couple sits close together on a dark sofa in a room lit by candles and warm lamps at night. The woman in a floral top turns to the man in an olive t-shirt and talks to him, smiling. He turns his head towards her, raises his index finger in front of his chest, shakes it and says no. She keeps hold of his arm and bursts out laughing while he holds the finger up and keeps saying no.

A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.

Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.
videos.said: I can't see anything. This way?

videos.desc: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.

A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.

A cobbled city square with cafe terraces and pastel townhouses. A young man stands alone in the middle of the square playing an accordion, his open case on the stones in front of him. A few passers-by slow down, then more stop, a cyclist halts, and within seconds dozens of people have collected around him in a wide ring. By the end a large crowd fills the square and everyone is clapping. A woman with a long red plait watches from the foreground.

A man in a black tuxedo straightens his bow tie in a hotel mirror while a second man watches, walks out through a white door into a garden, waits with his back to the camera in front of a large arch of white and pink roses with guests seated on the lawn, then turns and smiles with a white rose pinned to his lapel.

A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.
videos.said: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?

videos.desc: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.

A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.

An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.

On a cobbled stone bridge at sunset a young man in a grey suit drops onto one knee and holds up an open ring box to a young woman in a yellow dress. She claps both hands over her mouth in tears. A close-up shows the diamond ring in the black velvet box against the golden sunset; an accordion player and passers-by watch from behind. She says yes, they laugh, and she throws her arms around him as strangers applaud.

A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.

A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.

A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.

In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.

A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.

Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.

An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.

In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.

A boy, a woman and a man stand side by side at the wooden railing of a rooftop terrace at night, with the roofs of a town behind them. Fireworks climb and burst in the dark sky above them. All three keep their heads tilted back and their eyes fixed on the sky for the whole clip, mouths open in wonder, the boy pointing upwards once as another rocket goes up.
